inputs.text: Look at what’s happening in Jaipur. A student had to use her graduation ceremony—right in front of the Deputy Chief Minister—to publicly protest administrative issues just to get anyone to listen. The administration’s complete silence tells you everything you need to know about how these elite institutions treat the marginalized voices of young people demanding basic rights and structural reform. While the establishment tries to police tone and clutch their pearls over what is "appropriate" for the occasion, let's be clear: this student showed immense courage in standing up against bureaucratic oppression. It is deeply telling that those in power would rather maintain the comfortable illusion of institutional harmony than address the systemic injustices and daily challenges forced upon students.
